authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner guru explicitly gives Kalasha gūrak heavy, Jaunsari garūo, Nepali garũo/garuṅo/garaũ/garũ and the Kotgarhi gɔrkɔ extension. The unprefixed survey forms match this family, with local vowel reduction, inflection and nasal extensions preserved. The Danuwar/Bote variants are a qualified comparison with the adjacent Nepali family, without claiming that their precise contact history is resolved.

proposals.evidence: Turner *udguru explicitly gives Kalasha agūrak, Bashkarik ugūr, Torwali ūgū, Palula úguro/úṅguro and Shina Kohistani hăgúro heavy. These prefixed northwestern forms fit that family rather than unprefixed guru. The local aspiration/frication and initial h are retained; Turner himself marks the explanation of emphatic h as uncertain.
